title: Memories content in a veyq-subtree manifest
description: The `content` of a Memories node in a download (ADR 0082, docs/apps/memories.md): what the envelope, core's ../veyq-subtree.schema.json, leaves opaque. A content of `type` `memories.memory` or `memories.chapter` is one of these; Memories' own `validateMemoryContent` (src/web/src/features/memories/exportImport.ts) checks it before an import writes anything, its caps pinned to this file by that module's test. Payloads are core's shape (`payload` in the envelope).

memory.description: Memories: the content of a MEMORY node. Its chapters are the node's CHAPTER children, each with its own `memories.chapter` content; the media listed here are the Memory's own.

participants.description: Who was there, as display names (text only): ids mean nothing in another instance, so an import never restores them (ADR 0083).

chapter.description: Memories: the content of a CHAPTER node - the same fields as a Memory's (media, date, place, cover, participants, banner, music).

file.description: The pristine original, never a derivative.

capturedAt.description: The capture time as the Memory shows it (EXIF, the file's time, or the member's correction).

location.description: Informational: an import re-reads the coordinate from the file's own EXIF (there is no way to seal one the file lacks) and restores only `place`. Version 1 left it out when `options.includeLocation` was false.

place.description: The place name the Memory shows.

exif.description: Camera EXIF the original carries, as read; open. Version 1 left out the locating tags when `options.includeLocation` was false.

contributor.description: Text only: who added the medium ("Anna"). Not an identity; an import never maps it to a member.

capturedAtCorrected.description: Present when the member had corrected the capture time (an override); an import restores it as one.

place.description: The Memory's place as it is sealed in the node's metadata (name, how it was named, whether its position is derived from the media or fixed). Version 1 left it out when `options.includeLocation` was false.

cover.description: The cover: the node's own uploaded image (a payload), framed by a normalized 0..1 crop.

banner.description: The banner (uc.memory.banner): its own image or video as a payload (and a video's poster), framed by a fill or fit frame around a normalized 0..1 focal point.

music.description: The background music (uc.memory.music, ADR 0131): at most one playlist per service, as the service names it. An import seals it into the node's meta again.
